summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting completion of its capital-structure simplification following shareholder approval at an October 8, 2026 EGM. Aegon repurchased all outstanding Common Shares B held by largest shareholder Vereniging Aegon Americas, converting them into common shares with equal voting rights on a 40-to-1 basis, executed October 15, 2026, terminating the voting-rights agreement and call option. Interim bye-laws aligning governance with US practice were adopted. Redomiciliation to the US is expected effective around January 1, 2028, with renaming to Transamerica Inc. Watch regulatory and operational transition milestones ahead of the 2028 effective date.
